in_marathi.name: Hitin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Radiant, Shining
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hitin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hitin is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'hita' meaning sun. The name signifies radiance, brightness, and shining. In Hindu mythology, the sun god, Surya, is a symbol of power, energy, and vitality. Hitin embodies these qualities, making it an excellent choice for a baby boy.
